checks.physical_coverage_scope: True outer single decode router D2H cudaStreamSynchronize precedes planning; existing single model stream and max_seq=1/MTPoff scope required.

checks.explicit_phase: Outer T==1 AND kSingleDecode AND !HasRequest; prefill singleton T_sub==1 alone cannot activate.
checks.ring_safety: Existing l2_mu retained around eligibility and one reserve; claim/event-ready rules unchanged; no new waits; source-ring claims remain protected. Publication, old mapping invalidation, abort and event paths unchanged except counter.
checks.counters: Worker-local StatsDelta Reset/Merge include six counters; caller adds plans before worker dispatch; inline and worker barriers merge once. attempts partition by preferred/fallback/unavailable; changed and published subset preferred.
